! Synthetic Cisco IOS-style router configuration. No real credentials or addresses.
version 15.7
service timestamps log datetime msec
hostname TEST-RTR
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
username synthetic-admin privilege 15 secret 9 SYNTHETIC-LOCAL-HASH
enable secret 9 SYNTHETIC-ENABLE-HASH
ip ssh version 2
ip http authentication aaa
no ip http server
ip http secure-server
ip access-list standard MGMT-SOURCES
 10 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
 20 remark synthetic management range
!
access-list 110 permit tcp 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 22
snmp-server community SYNTHETIC-COMMUNITY RO MGMT-SOURCES
snmp-server group SECURE-GROUP v3 priv access MGMT-SOURCES
snmp-server user SYNTHETIC-SNMP-USER SECURE-GROUP v3 auth sha SYNTHETIC-AUTH-KEY priv aes 128 SYNTHETIC-PRIV-KEY access MGMT-SOURCES
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description SYNTHETIC-UPLINK
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group 110 in
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 SYNTHETIC-OSPF-KEY
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 10
 router-id 192.0.2.1
 area 0 authentication message-digest
 network 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
!
vlan 10
 name SYNTHETIC-USERS
!
line console 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
 login local
!
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
 access-class MGMT-SOURCES in
 login authentication default
!
end
